definitions.explanation: Something that requires very little effort or is physically comfortable. A casual, childish-sounding variant of 楽 (easy/comfortable). Has an endearing, lighthearted tone.

examples.japanese: この{靴|くつ}は{楽|らく}ちんだ。
{電子|でんし}レンジで{作|つく}れるから{楽|らく}ちんだよ。
examples.english: You can make it in the microwave, so it's easy.

examples.japanese: {在宅|ざいたく}{勤務|きんむ}は{通勤|つうきん}しなくていいから{楽|らく}ちんだけど、{運動|うんどう}{不足|ぶそく}になりがちだ。
examples.english: Working from home is easy because you don't have to commute, but you tend to lack exercise.

notes:
USAGE:
An informal, friendly variant of {楽|らく}. The ちん suffix gives it a cute, playful tone. Commonly used in casual conversation, product descriptions (especially for comfortable clothing and shoes), and advertising. Not appropriate for formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽|らく}ちんな{服|ふく}: comfortable clothes
- {楽|らく}ちんな{靴|くつ}: comfortable shoes
- {楽|らく}ちんレシピ: easy recipe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {楽|らく}: easy, comfortable (standard, all registers)
- {簡単|かんたん}: simple, easy (focuses on simplicity rather than comfort)
